label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): plan only. No candidate data has been collected; result fields are empty.
intervention: Break-even methods module with microteaching, observation and reteach
intended_performance: Teacher candidates teach break-even analysis with a correct spreadsheet model and follow up on students' actual responses, in microteaching and later in a field-placement lesson
human_data_boundary: The teacher-preparation program collects candidate work and observations under its own policies and consent; human supervisors rate them. The agent drafts instruments and checks answer keys by execution; it records no candidate scores, observations or outcomes.
revisit_if: Fewer than half of reteach segments show look-for OB4 after feedback; then revisit the worked-example segment before the next cohort

measures.description: Candidate's spreadsheet and queries executed against answer-key.json (business accuracy and technology fluency lines, scored separately)
measures.baseline: Diagnostic break-even item at the start of session 1
